popCulture.title: Seven Against Thebes
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: Aeschylus' reluctant prophet at the seventh gate — Amphiaraus marches knowing he will die, bribed into war by Eriphyle.

popCulture.title: Amphiaraus
popCulture.description: The Argive seer swallowed by the earth before Thebes — oracle-hero of Oropos and father of Alcmaeon's revenge.

popCulture.title: Epigoni (play)
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Sophocles' lost sequel where Amphiaraus' charge to Alcmaeon — avenge me on your mother — drives the next generation's war.
